name: La Residence Hue Ho & Spa
insider_take: Step into the golden age of French Indochina at La Residence Hue Hotel & Spa, a stunning colonial masterpiece set along the serene Perfume River in the heart of Vietnam's imperial city.
whats_special: Originally built in 1930 as the residence of the French Governor of Annam, the hotel is a living piece of Vietnamese history, blending Art Deco elegance with imperial Vietnamese charm. Perfectly positioned opposite the Imperial Citadel of Hue — a UNESCO World Heritage Site — guests enjoy front-row views of one of Southeast Asia's most storied landmarks. The award-winning Le Spa offers traditional Vietnamese healing rituals and treatments inspired by the beauty secrets once practiced by royalty in the Nguyen Dynasty imperial court. The hotel's pool deck offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Perfume River, making it one of the most photogenic spots in all of Hue.
pro_tip: Book a room facing the Perfume River and request a late checkout — watching the river mist slowly lift over the Imperial Citadel at sunrise from your private balcony is an experience you simply cannot rush.
dont_miss: Royal Dinning at Le Parfum Restaurant: Savor meticulously crafted royal Hue cuisine, where centuries-old recipes from the Nguyen imperial kitchens are beautifully reimagined. A Dragon Boat Ride: Just steps from the hotel, hop aboard a traditional wooden dragon boat for a sunset cruise along the Perfume River to the iconic Thien Mu Pagoda. The Imperial Citadel: Cross the street and step directly into the historic Hue Citadel complex — a sprawling UNESCO-listed royal city that once served as the seat of Vietnam's last dynasty.
pros: Prime riverside location offering stunning Perfume River views
Full-service spa with traditional Vietnamese wellness treatments
Historic French colonial architecture and elegant design
Convenient access to Hue Imperial City and cultural attractions
cons: Limited dining variety with single restaurant option
Heritage building may have older infrastructure in some areas
